This project uses shared development guidelines.

If a `_guidelines/` folder exists in the project root:

- MUST read `_guidelines/_index/MASTER_INDEX.md` before any task
- Prefix all file loads with `_guidelines/`

Otherwise, use the canonical source:

- MUST read `_guidelines/_index/MASTER_INDEX.md` (use `_guidelines/` mirror if available in the project)
- Load relevant guideline files by task type
